title: Agentic Peer-to-Peer Networks: From Content Distribution to Capability and Action Sharing
abstract: arXiv:2603.03753v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The ongoing shift of Artificial Intelligence (AI) from centralized cloud application programming interfaces (APIs) to local inference on edge devices is enabling Client-Side Autonomous Agents (CSAAs) - persistent personal agents that can plan, access local context, and invoke tools on behalf of users. As these agents collaborate directly, they form Agentic Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Networks. Unlike classic overlays exchanging static, hash-indexed content (e.g., BitTorrent), agentic P2P exchanges dynamic, heterogeneous capabilities that are potentially unsafe, requiring semantic discovery, drift management, and risk-aware execution. translated_title: 智能体对等网络：从内容分发到能力与行动共享
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）正从集中式云应用程序编程接口（API）向边缘设备本地推理持续转变，这使得客户端自主代理（CSAAs）成为可能——这类持久的个人代理能够进行规划、访问本地上下文并代表用户调用工具。当这些代理直接协作时，它们便形成了智能体对等网络。与交换静态的、以哈希索引内容的经典覆盖网络（如BitTorrent）不同，智能体P2P网络交换的是动态的、异构的且可能不安全的能力，因此需要语义发现、漂移管理和风险感知执行。我们概述了实现这种协作的网络基础。为了组织这一设计空间，我们提出了一种基于平面的参考架构，将连接性、语义发现和执行三者解耦。为支持漂移环境下的发现，我们引入了带签名的软状态能力描述符，以支持意图……
tldr: 该论文提出了智能体对等网络这一新范式，设计了一种将连接性、语义发现与执行解耦的基于平面的参考架构，并引入带签名的软状态能力描述符，以支持边缘设备上客户端自主代理之间安全的能力共享与协作。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Agentic Peer-to-Peer Networks as a new paradigm, introducing a plane-based reference architecture that decouples connectivity, semantic discovery, and execution, along with signed soft-state capability descriptors to enable secure capability sharing and collaboration among client-side autonomous agents on edge devices.
